title: TWO READERS
rule: one set of facts, two readers: a switch rewrites every line for a hiring manager or for an engineer
description: Eight pieces of work in a log beside one fixed frame. It opens on a shipped product: the Bayyinah TV home page, with the free-trial button ringed for 'Members subscribe on the web, iPhone or Android'. Row 02 is the billing report that asked the database 16 times and gave up, and now asks 2 times and finishes. A switch at the top, 'Same facts for: Hiring manager · Engineer', rewrites every line. The hiring-manager view is the default and fully plain; the engineer view names the stack. The same facts, two audiences.
signature: Paper #F3EFE6, ink #1B1A17, muted #5E5A52, one vermilion accent #B8311B (5.2:1 on paper). Newsreader for the plain reader, JetBrains Mono for the engineer: the face change is the signal that the reader changed. The two faces load through the FontFace API; the page waits at most 300 ms, and a face that comes later is kept for the next visit, so text never rewraps in view (local Georgia and Menlo stand in). Desktop: a 560 px log (identity, sticky switch bar, rows) and a 4:5 frame (573 x 716 at 1440 x 900), sticky, with a count and caption under it. Row 01 plate is the public Bayyinah TV home page; row 02 is a vermilion card ('16' struck, 16 ticks, 'Gave up'; '2', 2 ticks, 'Finished'). Read to Feed shows its public store screenshot (36% and 90% read); Incentiv, Viva Fresh, Read to Feed and Dukagjini crops end on whole UI parts and stand on a colour sampled from the screen around the crop. Design System v2 shows ready-made buttons and inputs to the hiring manager and the token card to the engineer. Every line is two versions in one grid cell, so a switch never moves the page (CLS 0). Switch: each visible line fades (120 ms, ease-out), then the other reader's words write in with a clip-path wipe (240 ms, ease-out, from 120 ms), top to bottom with a 30 ms stagger; off-screen lines swap at once. The hairline hides at the switch and draws again (180 ms) from the new last word. Rows become current at 42% of the viewport after 160 ms; the plate cross-fades in 200 ms; the line never follows the scroll. Keyboard: arrow keys in the log jump with no travel; the switch is a radio group, and a key switch swaps the words at once. The reader is kept in the URL (?read=engineer). Phone: each row carries its own 4:3 plate with the same ring; the switch bar sticks at the top with its rule inset to the 24 px gutter. Reduced motion: words swap at once, the line appears, nothing plays.
holdback: Lowest: original, 7/10. The switch that rewrites every line is new, but the page around it is projector's log beside a sticky frame, a known scrollytelling layout. Other limits: the hook is still behind a click, so a recruiter who never presses 'Engineer' sees a calm plain page; the engineer h1 keeps the height of the longer plain h1 (about 27 px of extra space); at 1440 the Incentiv and Dukagjini plates show 100 to 160 px of their own card or app colour above and below the crop, because their content is wider than a 4:5 frame and is never upscaled; the Bayyinah TV ring (the free-trial button) proves 'members subscribe on the web', not the iPhone and Android part; in the dev server a dev-only module evaluation (360 to 470 ms) can hold the first reveal past 300 ms, while the production build reveals in 246 to 277 ms with fonts 2.5 s late.

chroma.method: scratchpad/chroma6r.mjs logic (review/loop8b/two-readers/chroma-tr.mjs) on review/loop8b/two-readers/final/d-top.png (1440 x 900), captured last. The first plate is now the dark Bayyinah TV page, not the vermilion card.

fixed: First screen shows a real product: Bayyinah TV is row 01 (public home page, free-trial button ringed); the 16 -> 2 card moves to row 02 (critic 1, devil)
Own identity line with the level: 'has built web and mobile apps for 5+ years: apps people learn from, shop in and read in'
Engineer view keeps 'Part of two rewrites' and its h1 says what shipped where, not a skills list (critic 2, devil)
Switch label 'Same facts for' sits next to the control (3 words); the 13-15 px note under the bar is gone (critic 4, devil)

Switch motion: the red strike is gone (a strike reads as 'wrong', and the round-8 260 ms frame showed a left-over pen line); words fade 120 ms, then write in 240 ms (devil, followed over the critic's 9 because the frame proved the defect)
Read to Feed uses its public store screenshot (36% and 90% read) instead of the recreation; no empty lower half (devil, research rule 6)
Design System v2 in the hiring-manager view shows buttons and inputs, no token names; the token card stays in the engineer view (critic 3)
Incentiv crop is the sign-in card on its own card colour, no page ground band (critic 3)
Viva Fresh and Dukagjini crops end on whole UI parts: no cut product cards, no half 'FAN' chip
Care rebuild wording: 'Most screens rebuilt in React in 2026'; Bayyinah '34 pages' (not routes); Design System 'with the team'
Phone: switch bar rule inset to the 24 px gutter; buttons fit on one row at 375 (ends at x 347)
Email and footer links are at least 48 x 44 px; no target under 44 px outside inert plates at 375, 390, 540, 1024, 1280, 1440
Fonts: FontFace API with a 300 ms cap, late faces kept for the next visit; CLS 0 with fonts 2.5 s late (was 0.0012)
text-wrap: balance on problem and result lines (no one-word orphans)
